messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Added a **Game name** field under Reproduce a game. Exported snapshots include the name, and loading a snapshot restores it. Restart keeps the name; starting a new game clears it.

Pasted snapshots now load regardless of property order. Older unnamed snapshots and unnamed exports keep working, and validation still rejects unknown or invalid fields. Updated the save/load notes in [README.md](/work/README.md:30).

`git diff --check` passed. Tests were not run.
